bug.title: A reviewer without the local review secret gets a blank form for their revealed review; gate-opening update confirmation is wrong; v1 page shows v2 reviews
bug.symptoms: From /me "My reviews", a reviewer in a browser that does not hold their review secret opens /review/{id} and sees an empty rubric with "Commit review" and no sign of their revealed (and updated) review; submitting it is refused with "This reviewer has already committed a review of paper 'bafyrei...'; a person may commit one review per paper. Nothing was sent." (raw record id) When an update is the second review committed on the newer version (so it opens the gate), the confirmation still says "Your written report unseals once 2 reviews are committed on this version, or on {date}" although the public page already shows it On /p/{id}/v1 the Reviews tab shows "Version 2 · 2 reviews" (the latest version's listing) instead of version 1's; the header count also includes carried earlier-version reviews while none was committed on v2
bug.reproduction_steps: Journey 13 steps 9 and 11 as solheim in a fresh browser (screenshots/13-new-version-and-review-update/s5-16-me-link-blank-form.png, s5-15-solheim-second-commit-probe.png, s5-11-solheim-updated.png) Journey 08 step 7: open /p/{id}/v1 of a two-version paper, Reviews tab
bug.expected: The review page detects (via the reviews listing / a reviewer-scoped API read) that the signed-in account already has a review on this paper and shows it read-only (recommendation, scores, report, status sealed/revealed, version) with "Update for v{latest}" when applicable and "Import your review key" when the local secret is needed to act, never an empty Commit form; the one-review-per-paper refusal (409) carries a human message without CIDs and the form maps it to "You already reviewed this paper"; the update confirmation states the actual gate state after the update (report public now when this update opened the gate); the Reviews tab follows the version being viewed and its header counts reviews committed on that version separately from carried earlier-version reviews
bug.actual: Dead-end blank form; wrong confirmation; wrong version listing

constraints.constraint: REV-4 sealing and REV-3 one-review-per-paper are unchanged; the API never reveals another reviewer's identity

bug.title: Share-image URLs ignore a loopback NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL in dev builds; footer "CAR archive" is not a link
bug.symptoms: With NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://localhost:3200 set for a non-production build, og:image and twitter:image still point at http://localhost:3000: resolveSiteUrl() in site-metadata.ts discards any loopback value outside production and uses DEFAULT_SITE_URL The footer's "CAR archive" label next to Public export is plain text
bug.reproduction_steps: Build with NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://localhost:3200, curl / and a paper page, read meta og:image (journey 16 step 5)
bug.expected: Outside production any absolute http(s) URL in NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL (loopback included) is used as given; only when it is unset/empty does the default apply; production keeps refusing unset or loopback values; the footer links the export with the "CAR archive" note as part of the same link or as a secondary link to the export documentation on /network
bug.actual: Wrong port in previews; dead label

bug.title: Needs-your-attention and notification texts show raw ids and actions, list non-actionable items, and stay after they are resolved
bug.symptoms: /me "Needs your attention" shows "Moderation decision: dismiss on sch:nu5m-cysk-3kl4" / "hold on sch:..." (raw action word, id instead of title); an author sees the dismissal of a flag against their paper as needing attention "A co-author consent is waiting for your signature on version 1." names no paper and stays while the consent page shows all signed "The post you wrote was hidden..." and "A moderator put your paper on hold." do not name the paper; "Recovery approval" does not name the requester; after the email is verified, the "Confirm your email address" notification stays "My reviews" still labels a review "v1" after the reviewer updated it for v2
bug.expected: Attention items are only things the viewer must act on (sign a consent, answer a recovery request, respond to a hold/appeal outcome that allows an appeal, review invitation) and each reads in words with the paper title and a link (e.g. 'Your paper "{title}" was put on hold: {reason}. You can appeal until {date}.'); informational outcomes (dismissals, listings) go to Notifications only; every notification text names its subject (paper title, post excerpt, requester name); a notification whose action is completed (consent signed, email verified, recovery answered or closed) is marked read and leaves Needs your attention at that moment; My reviews shows the version of the reviewer's latest review

bug.title: Semantic search lists each version as a separate hit, shows negative match scores and an internal model label
bug.symptoms: A two-version paper appears twice (v1 and v2 as separate hits); a result shows "-1% match"; the ranking is labelled "ranked by hashing-v1-1024"
bug.reproduction_steps: Journey 02: semantic search on a query matching a two-version paper (screenshots/02-search-and-discover/s5-04-semantic.png)
bug.expected: Search returns one hit per paper (its latest listed version, mentioning "v2 of 2"), match percentages are clamped to 0-100 and hidden below a relevance floor, and the ranking label reads "Semantic match" with the embedder name only in a tooltip/technical detail

bug.title: Verification copy: offline-check guidance points nowhere, three size formats, ungrammatical counts, signature count unclear, /verify hints stale
bug.symptoms: The archive menu's "How to verify" says the Proof tab explains the offline check, but the Proof tab only shows `scholium verify sch:.../v1 --node http://localhost:8200` (an online check) Sizes appear as "3.0 KB", "759 B" and "735 bytes -> 759 bytes" on different pages "All 1 prev link match", "Signed by all 2 listed authors"; a hyphen where a dash belongs in the /verify result "2 versions · 2 signatures" for 2 authors on 2 versions does not say what is counted /verify's idle hint still says "Enter a version id and drop a file"; its placeholder sch:6sel-2dio-orm6/v2 is not a real paper; dropping a paper archive (.car) reports "does not match" with no explanation The Versions tab and margin say "Anchor pending" with no hint that anchoring is off
bug.expected: The Proof tab has an "Offline check" section with the exact commands for the downloaded archive (scholium verify sch-{id}.car) and the online form, matching the download menu's wording; one shared formatBytes (B / KB / MB, 1 decimal) is used by Files, compare and /verify; counts pluralise naturally ("The previous-version link matches", "Signed by both listed authors"); the indicator says what it counts ("{m} author signatures across {n} versions", counting each author signature on version and consent records); /verify's hint matches its behaviour (drop a file; version optional), uses the current paper's id or a neutral placeholder, and recognises a .car archive with "This is a paper archive - verify it offline with: scholium verify {file}"; anchoring is described the same way everywhere ("Anchoring is not enabled on this node yet")
